description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' wraps Android's native Log utility in a custom Logger interface, enabling logs to be propagated through a chain of log nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that implements LogNode and wraps Android's Log utility to output logs, supporting chaining to other LogNodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message using Android's Log utility; supports chaining to the next LogNode.
